ValidationRule.description: The box diagonal angle (ATAN, ASIN, ACOS, TAN) must stay in a stable band: height/length slope and normalised ratios cannot be degenerate.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NULLVALUE(Length_Cm__c, 0) > 0, NULLVALUE(Width_Cm__c, 0) > 0, NOT(ISBLANK(Height_Cm__c)), OR( ATAN(Height_Cm__c / Length_Cm__c) * 180 / PI() > 80, ASIN(MIN(1, Width_Cm__c / MAX(Length_Cm__c, Width_Cm__c, Height_Cm__c))) < ACOS(0.99), ROUND(TAN(ATAN(Width_Cm__c / Length_Cm__c)) * Length_Cm__c, 1) <> ROUND(Width_Cm__c, 1) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Package dimensions form a degenerate shape.
